subline.zh: 升级版 GPP 烟弹，搭配 PRO-FOCS 4.0。

body.en: UWELL built the G4 around flavour: the upgraded pods and its flavour tech work together.
body.zh: UWELL 以口味为核心打造 G4：升级烟弹与口感技术协同发挥。

text.en: Cartridge life up to 35% longer (UWELL lab tests)
text.zh: 烟弹寿命最高提升 35%（UWELL 实验室数据）

text.en: Flavour satisfaction up to 35% higher (UWELL lab tests)
text.zh: 口感满意度最高提升 35%（UWELL 实验室数据）

subline.en: Two modes, picked on a 0.85-inch colour screen.
subline.zh: 两种模式，在 0.85 英寸彩屏上切换。

body.en: Storm hits fast, like a roller coaster. Waves stays smooth and steady, like the London Eye.
body.zh: Storm 来得快，像坐过山车；Waves 平稳顺滑，像坐伦敦眼。

text.en: Themed screen UI: on/off, mode, puffs, day/night, charging
text.zh: 主题界面：开关机、模式、口数、日/夜、充电

body.en: Wake the screen, lock the button, set the wattage, open the menu or switch off — without a second button.
body.zh: 亮屏、锁定按键、调功率、进菜单、开关机，一个按键全包。

text.zh: 按 2 下：锁定/解锁按键点火

subline.en: Three ways to set the draw.

body.en: Slide the airflow valve, load the pod the other way round, or combine the two.
body.zh: 推动气流滑块、把烟弹反向装入，或两者结合。

title.zh: 兼容所有 GPP 烟弹

subline.en: Old GPP pods and the upgraded ones.
subline.zh: 旧款与升级款 GPP 烟弹都能用。

body.en: The upgraded pods also fit the G3 series, and their mouthpiece is reshaped to sit better on the lips.
body.zh: 升级款烟弹也适用于 G3 系列，烟嘴重新设计，含着更贴合。

text.en: Refill without taking the pod out
text.zh: 无需取下烟弹即可注油

body.en: Ultrasonic welding seals the pod against leaks, and a U-shaped channel improves the airflow.
body.zh: 超声波焊接提升防漏，U 形通道改善气流。

en.lede: Flavour comes first on the G4 — and a thumb-sized colour screen lets you pick how it hits.

sections.heading: G4 or G4 mini?
paragraphs: The G4 has the colour screen, the two modes and a button; the [G4 mini](/products/caliburn-g4-mini) has no screen and fires when you draw.
The G4 holds 1300mAh, the mini 1100mAh — and the mini weighs about 46 g against the G4's 54.7 g.

sections.heading: How is the G4 different from the G4 Classic?
paragraphs: The [G4 Classic](/products/caliburn-g4-classic) is a different body: aluminium, no screen, RGB light at the base and a 1400mAh battery. Both take GPP pods.

zh.lede: G4 把口味放在第一位，还有一块拇指大小的彩屏，让你选择想要的口感。

sections.heading: G4 还是 G4 mini？
paragraphs: G4 有彩屏、两种模式和按键；[G4 mini](/products/caliburn-g4-mini) 没有屏幕，吸一下就出烟。
G4 电池 1300mAh，mini 是 1100mAh；mini 约 46 克，G4 约 54.7 克。

sections.heading: G4 和 G4 Classic 有什么不同？
paragraphs: [G4 Classic](/products/caliburn-g4-classic) 是另一种机身：铝合金、没有屏幕、底部有 RGB 灯光，电池 1400mAh。两款都用 GPP 烟弹。

body.en: A slim, simple body that sits easily in the hand and the pocket.
body.zh: 纤薄简洁，握在手里、放进口袋都轻松。

body.en: PRO-FOCS 4.0 keeps the true taste of your e-liquid.
body.zh: PRO-FOCS 4.0 保留烟油原本的味道。

text.en: Flavour satisfaction up to 35% higher (UWELL lab tests)
text.zh: 口感满意度最高提升 35%（UWELL 实验室数据）

text.en: Cartridge life up to 35% longer (UWELL lab tests)
text.zh: 烟弹寿命最高提升 35%（UWELL 实验室数据）

en.lede: Small, simple and ready to go — the G4 mini keeps the G4's flavour in a lighter body.

sections.heading: G4 mini or G4?
paragraphs: The mini has no screen and fires when you draw; the [G4](/products/caliburn-g4) adds a colour screen, two modes and a button.
The mini holds 1100mAh and weighs about 46 g; the G4 holds 1300mAh and weighs 54.7 g.

sections.heading: G4 mini or G5 Lite?
paragraphs: Neither has a screen. The [G5 Lite](/products/caliburn-g5-lite) carries a bigger 1600mAh battery with a 4-bar light; the G4 mini is the slimmer, lighter one.

zh.lede: 小巧、简单、拿起就走——G4 mini 用更轻的机身保留 G4 的口味。

sections.heading: G4 mini 还是 G4？
paragraphs: mini 没有屏幕，吸一下就出烟；[G4](/products/caliburn-g4) 多了彩屏、两种模式和按键。
mini 电池 1100mAh、约 46 克；G4 电池 1300mAh、约 54.7 克。

sections.heading: G4 mini 还是 G5 Lite？
paragraphs: 两款都没有屏幕。[G5 Lite](/products/caliburn-g5-lite) 电池更大（1600mAh），配 4 格电量灯；G4 mini 更纤薄、更轻。

body.en: Countless micro CNC passes leave a zirconia-smooth finish, and the one-piece winged shape sits smoothly in the hand.
body.zh: 无数道微米级 CNC 工序带来锆石般顺滑的表面，一体式翼形流线设计握感顺手。

subline.en: A main sensor and a backup, in sync.
subline.zh: 主传感器与备用传感器同步工作。

body.en: Two sensors work together, so every puff is caught.
body.zh: 两个传感器协同，每一口都能准确捕捉。

body.en: The base glows in shifting colours as you puff — the glow of classic e-cigarettes, with a modern twist.
body.zh: 吸烟时底部灯光渐变流动，重现经典电子烟的光芒，并加入现代感。

text.en: Green: battery high · Blue: medium · Red: low
text.zh: 绿色：电量高 · 蓝色：中 · 红色：低
按 2 下：锁定/解锁按键
按 1 下：启动 / 显示电量

title.en: Two ways for air, two ways to fire

subline.en: Set it the way you vape.

body.en: Turn the airflow without steps or flip the pod; fire with a light press of the button or simply draw.
body.zh: 气流可无级调节，也可反装烟弹；轻按按键或直接吸都能启动。

subline.en: Refill without taking the pod out.
subline.zh: 无需取下烟弹即可注油。

body.en: A clear window shows how much e-liquid is left.
body.zh: 透明视窗，余量一目了然。

body.en: Paired with U² anti-leak, so the taste stays clean and the e-liquid stays in the pod.
body.zh: 搭配 U² 防漏技术，口味纯净，烟油留在烟弹里。

en.lede: UWELL's tenth-anniversary Caliburn: a machined aluminium body, colour light at the base, no screen.

sections.heading: G4 Classic or G4?
paragraphs: The [G4](/products/caliburn-g4) has a colour screen and two modes; the Classic has no screen and shows the battery in light. The Classic holds 1400mAh against the G4's 1300mAh. Both take GPP pods.

sections.heading: G4 Classic or G5 Lite?
paragraphs: Both skip the screen. The [G5 Lite](/products/caliburn-g5-lite) has a 1600mAh battery and a two-layer shell; the Classic is aluminium, with RGB light and twin sensors.

zh.lede: UWELL 十周年纪念款 Caliburn：精工铝合金机身，底部彩色灯光，没有屏幕。

sections.heading: G4 Classic 还是 G4？
paragraphs: [G4](/products/caliburn-g4) 有彩屏和两种模式；Classic 没有屏幕，用灯光显示电量。Classic 电池 1400mAh，G4 是 1300mAh。两款都用 GPP 烟弹。

sections.heading: G4 Classic 还是 G5 Lite？
paragraphs: 两款都没有屏幕。[G5 Lite](/products/caliburn-g5-lite) 电池 1600mAh，双层外壳；Classic 是铝合金机身，配 RGB 灯光和双传感器。
